Name: The Neighborly Collection - Building Replacement
Author: cajcbell
Description:
[size=6][center][b]The Neighborly Collection[/b][/center][/size]
[i]I made this mod because I love the weird vanilla flavor of Stardew Valley, and wanted a building set that meshed well with both the base game and other building mods. The theme follows the neighbor cabin color scheme and texture design. Obelisks are designed with the idea that the Junimo built them out of old-growth tree stumps.
[/i]

[center][size=5][b]Credits[/b][/size][/center]
[i]First things first, credit where it is due! This mod was a labor of love and time, inspired from several directions. While it was mostly made with vanilla assets and my own art, there were other contributors that helped enormously. Permission was granted from each person, and I cannot thank them enough.
[/i]
[list]
[*]The farmhouse was directly made by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/windvalley?gameId=1303]windvalley[/url]﻿, found in their original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27275?tab=description]Seasonal Cabin Style Farmhouses[/url]﻿
[*]The sheds use fronts made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/10270305]firekuwon[/url], found in their original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26233]Small and Medium Sheds[/url]
[*]The slimehutch uses greenhouse parts by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5575844]Lumisteria[/url], found in their compiled mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/196]House and Building Customization[/url]
[*]Small seasonal flower details made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/108124018]HimeTarts[/url], in their shared tilesheets from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20139]HxW Tilesheets[/url]. That mod is required for the use of this one!
[/list][b]
[/b][center][size=5][b]Compatib[/b][b]ilities[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*]This mod was specifically made to mesh well with HxW's buildings, particularly their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28730]HxW Tea Shop[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28723]HxW Tea Conservatory[/url]﻿. There is a color option for the greenhouses to match the (default) conservatory.
[*]A recolor for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/7886557]omena007[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28639]Workshop[/url] is included, with permission. The original mod is required if you would like to use the recolor.
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753?tab=posts]SVE[/url]. Required if you want to use the Premium buildings, Winery, or change Grandpa's Shed.
[*]Huge thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/MisguidedKerbal/mods?gameId=1303]MisguidedKerbal[/url]﻿ for a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]﻿ comptability, which can be found in this [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1yifNIAUtyUHcAhdqbuhrSjkyKVYGSaiU]google drive[/url]﻿. Just replace the folders inside the [CP] folder!
[/list][center][size=5]
[b]Planned Updates[/b][/size]

[size=3][b]2.0 now live![/b]
- fixed issue with Grandpa's Shed on Frontier Farm
- Separated CP Grandpa's Farm as a standalone
- Separated the CP Workshop recolor as a standalone
- Added RSV and East Scarp Obelisks
- Updated for 1.6.9 and SMAPI 4.1.7

[b]To-Do List:
- [/b]super big coop for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21800]Resource Chicken's[/url]﻿ custom building
- the RSV farmhouse and shed
[/size][/center]
[center][b]A note on Recolors:
[/b]I have decided not to create any recolors or Paint Masks. However I freely give permission to recolor or adjust these assets as you desire.
Please[b] link back to this mod[/b] and give credit where it is due.
Thank you![/center][b][size=5][center]﻿﻿[/center][/size][/b][center][b][size=5]﻿Troubleshooting[/size][/b]
[left][/left][/center][left][b]Alternative Textures[/b]
[list]
[*]The AT version REQUIRES[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url][b]﻿ [/b]to work!
[*]Buy the Paint Bucket from Robin for 500g
[*]Use on any building, during any season, and it will now be set!
[*][b]PSA - with AT, buildings cannot be changed if they are on top of a placed path (like bricks, cobblestones, etc).[/b]
[/list]
[b]Content Patcher[/b]
[list]
[*]The CP version replaces the default buildings, options can be adjusted in the config file or with GMCM
[*]The Workshop recolor is a direct replacement, similiar to Nyapu portrait extensions. Unzip into the [CP] Workshop folder.
[*]Grandpa's Shed is no longer included in the main CP file - it works better on its own since it includes a slight map patch. Unzip the standalone file into the Mods folder.
[/list]
[i][/i][/left][center][i]Thank you to everyone for the encouragement! Please enjoy!

[/i]-
